overview: The Royal Archives Interior preserves Shar Vahl’s historical, political, and arcane records.
history: The archives were established to preserve clan lineage and royal decrees.
Arcane logs were added after the founding of the Arcane Sanctum.
Sigil‑sealed vaults were constructed to protect sensitive documents.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the archives were expanded with new galleries.
Shadow‑Threat Watch gained limited access to monitor arcane anomalies.
hooks: A sigil‑sealed vault destabilizes, threatening ancient records.
A missing decree triggers a royal investigation.
An arcane log reveals a forgotten planar disturbance.
A clan lineage scroll is found to contain unexpected information.
